theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenRep_measure_eq_of_open_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ μ' : Measure (Rn N)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → μ' Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ O : Set (Rn N), IsOpen O → O ⊆ U → μ O = μ' O) → μ = μ'
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
